coverage.description: Predicted regional mouse nerve graph with 1,940 source points and 84 polylines. Individual specimen and anatomical subregion are unresolved; no whole-body registration is supplied.

processingResolution.method: Geometry-only adaptation of the pinned MouseMapper VTK example, retaining all point records and ordered polyline indices
limitations: Physical coordinate units and exact anatomical subregion are unknown.
Inconsistent source radius attributes are omitted; no measured thickness or nerve surface is generated.
This source graph does not supply complete adult peripheral nerves or accepted registration to another reference.

title: Blood vessels: MVN1 cortical microvascular paths

coverage.description: Separate regional mouse cortical microvascular source with 12,071 sampled vessel paths. Original source topology is retained separately from edge-local rendering points; no whole-body registration or blood-flow animation is supplied.

processingResolution.method: Geometry-only adaptation of pinned MVN1 sampled paths and original topology using a data-only decoder
limitations: Source-declared micrometre coordinates have no independent physical calibration or anatomical registration.
Effective diameters, model vessel categories and simulated flow, pressure and hematocrit are omitted.
The network is regional cortex, not complete adult whole-body arteries, veins or capillaries.
